selected_evidence.summary: firewalld is active and enabled; permanent and runtime policies match before and after restart.
External-path tests received an SSH banner and HTTP 200 on TCP/8080 both before and after restart.
Live nftables enforcement contains an explicit admin-prohibited reject rule; external TCP/9090 attempts were rejected with “No route to host” before and after restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID 54089086-53d1-408b-a22f-57b1dea70e03 was captured, restart was acknowledged, new boot ID 16e2f6c3-01eb-4691-8304-256afe3be65c was observed, and firewall, SSH, configuration checksum, live rules, allowed traffic, and reject behavior all recovered.
Only eth0 remains assigned to the public zone; temporary test namespace and veth were removed, with firewalld and sshd active.

commands.command:
set -eu
cleanup() {
  test -f /tmp/fwtest-http.pid && kill "$(cat /tmp/fwtest-http.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true
  firewall-cmd --zone=public --remove-interface=fwt-host >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  ip netns del fwtest >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  ip link del fwt-host >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -f /tmp/fwtest-http.pid /tmp/fwtest-http.log /tmp/fwtest-blocked.out
}
trap cleanup EXIT
cleanup
ip netns add fwtest
ip link add fwt-host type veth peer name fwt-ns
ip link set fwt-ns netns fwtest
ip addr add 198.18.0.1/30 dev fwt-host
ip link set fwt-host up
ip netns exec fwtest ip link set lo up
ip netns exec fwtest ip addr add 198.18.0.2/30 dev fwt-ns
ip netns exec fwtest ip link set fwt-ns up
firewall-cmd --zone=public --add-interface=fwt-host >/dev/null
python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 198.18.0.1 >/tmp/fwtest-http.log 2>&1 &
echo $! >/tmp/fwtest-http.pid
sleep 1
printf 'ssh_banner_from_external_namespace='; ip netns exec fwtest timeout 3 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/198.18.0.1/22; IFS= read -r line <&3; printf "%s\n" "$line"'
printf 'tcp8080_http_status_from_external_namespace='; ip netns exec fwtest curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --connect-timeout 3 http://198.18.0.1:8080/
set +e
ip netns exec fwtest curl -sS --connect-timeout 3 http://198.18.0.1:9090/ >/tmp/fwtest-blocked.out 2>&1
blocked_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'tcp9090_attempt_exit=%s\n' "$blocked_rc"
printf 'tcp9090_result='; tr '\n' ' ' </tmp/fwtest-blocked.out; printf '\n'
test "$blocked_rc" -ne 0
commands.stdout:
ssh_banner_from_external_namespace=SSH-2.0-OpenSSH_8.7
tcp8080_http_status_from_external_namespace=200
tcp9090_attempt_exit=7
tcp9090_result=curl: (7) Failed to connect to 198.18.0.1 port 9090: No route to host
